methods.label: Empty common interval
methods.explanation: For there to be no solution, \(x>a\) and \(x<3\) must have no common values. This requires \(a\geq3\) (when \(a=3\), \(x>3\) and \(x<3\) also have no common values).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 criterion for two strict bounds to have no common values, including the coincident-endpoint case.
